items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How long did Jones stay on snare drum? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh not very long. He didn't like it.

ctx.x: Years ago. Everybody was playing those barit trombone. The barit trombone. So he was the first one you saw. Best man. Best man I've seen.
How long did Jones stay on snare drum?
Oh not very long. He didn't like it. He didn't like it at all. And then what did he go to?
